decisions.hidden_reasoning:

I check whether Mega Evolution is available for my Garchomp, but it looks like it isn't an option right now despite holding Garchompite, so I'll plan without it.

If I bring my Garchomp in, their Garchomp's Earthquake would only hit neutrally since Ground vs Dragon/Ground is 1x damage, which is manageable. But Kingambit, being Dark/Steel, would take a 2x hit from Earthquake since Ground is super effective against Steel, making that swap riskier.

I'm also realizing Dragapult's Ghost-type moves like Shadow Claw would hit Kingambit for super effective damage since Ghost beats Dark, so Kingambit isn't a safe answer there either, while Garchomp stays neutral against Dragapult's Dragon/Ghost attacks.

For the speed comparison, their Garchomp at 48% HP could be faster or slower than mine depending on the roll, but my Garchomp with Earthquake should do solid damage to their already-weakened Garchomp while surviving their return Earthquake. I'll switch my Garchomp in and go for the Earthquake.
